entities.summary: Jirō Shiizaki was a lieutenant colonel in the Imperial Japanese Army in World War II. He served as a member of the staff of the domestic affairs section of the Military Affairs Bureau's War Affairs Section. Shiizaki was one of several members of that staff to participate in a coup in the early morning of 15 August 1945, the day the Emperor would declare Japan's surrender.

entities.summary: Jirō Shiizaki was a lieutenant colonel in the Imperial Japanese Army in World War II. He served as a member of the staff of the domestic affairs section of the Military Affairs Bureau's War Affairs Section. Shiizaki was one of several members of that staff to participate in a coup in the early morning of 15 August 1945, the day the Emperor would declare Japan's surrender.
